description: This file defines the SiloStatus enum representing different operational states of a silo in Orleans, along with extension methods for the enum, specifically the IsTerminating method.

classes.name: SiloStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of possible statuses for a silo, such as Created, Joining, Active, ShuttingDown, Stopping, and Dead.

classes.name: SiloStatusExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods for the SiloStatus enum, specifically the IsTerminating method that checks if a silo is in a terminating state.

methods.name: IsTerminating
methods.description: Returns true if the silo status indicates the silo is terminating (ShuttingDown, Stopping, or Dead), otherwise false.
